newsitem.title: USA: Viacom under pressure to sell unit - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Viacom under pressure to sell unit - WSJ.

text.p: Viacom Inc is fighting pressure from some big shareholders to spin off its Blockbuster Entertainment unit as it searches for ways to improve business for its video chain, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
The newspaper said fund managers owning Class B shares in Viacom wanted the company to spin off the chain.
But it said Viacom was looking at a number of options to increase sales at the chain like offering computer services at the stores to upgrade computers or install CD-ROM drives.
The company had apparently been talking with Intel Corp about the idea, it added.
The newspaper said Viacom was also thinking about opening more stores in rural areas, selling computer software and offering music and videos on the Internet.
